title: Unlocking Life's Algorithm with David Choe: Art, Insight & Survival
editorial_title: Peekaboo, paper coffee, stolen chips, art approval, and algorithm parody
summary: An 8:24 variety monologue moving from peekaboo/spider play and not-feeling-on-it disclosure into damaged sponsor/code wordplay, pray/play, a taped paper coffee cup and tongue burn, snack tasting and a playful dad/cameraman/Val chip accusation, art-for-self rhetoric immediately called a lie, delegated editing and virality/algorithm anxiety, then a parody of a prior love/trust/sorry aphorism through hugs, an explicit unsafe password joke, money, an uncertain promo code and an unmade weighted-stuffy pitch seeking a manufacturer. Every joke, accusation, bodily detail and commercial claim remains. Codes/passwords are never tested; no offer, theft, analytics, consent, product or voice fact is invented.
